name: Vocal Cord
description: Wires Vocal Cord's MCP server into OpenClaw, sets up real-time inbound (webhook with WebSocket fallback), and runs a 6-hourly pull-sync.

apiKey.description: Vocal Cord account UUID (acts as bearer token).

apiBase.description: Vocal Cord REST + MCP base URL.

wsBase.description: Vocal Cord WebSocket base URL (defaults to apiBase with wss://).

publicUrl.description: Public URL of THIS gateway (e.g. https://my-host.tailnet.ts.net). When set, the plugin asks vocalcord to deliver webhooks here. When omitted, vocalcord will fall back to using the source IP of the configure request and try to reach back; if that fails, the plugin falls back to a WebSocket subscription instead.

webhookPort.description: Port to bind the local webhook receiver on.

webhookPath.description: Path the local webhook receiver serves.

gatewayBaseUrl.description: OpenClaw Gateway base URL — the receiver POSTs to <gatewayBaseUrl>/hooks/wake.

hookToken.description: OpenClaw hooks bearer token (the value of `hooks.token` in the gateway config).
